source_evidence: Target date funds in these accounts may automatically shift toward a more conservative mix of investments as you approach your anticipated retirement date. All investments have some degree of risk.
question: Misconception: A target date fund guarantees that your investments will become risk-free by the time you retire.
answer: Correction: The source says target date funds may shift toward a more conservative mix as you approach your anticipated retirement date. A more conservative mix is not the same as a guarantee of no risk; the source notes that all investments involve some degree of risk.
